paragraphs.text:
As your glance passes over the ledge of quartz pegmatite where 
you spent the night, you spot something that glitters. You take 
your knife and scratch out a bit of the mineral deposited in the 
vein. It seems to be gold!
You scratch out the best map you can before moving on.
Record the keyword CHARCOAL. Go to 513.
